summary: Tainan's own 2026 plan (環保局, announced 2025-12-22, later amended) pays only for electric scooters; there is no city subsidy for new gasoline scooters and no scrap-only cash for owners. City-only amounts for a heavy (普通重型) electric scooter: NT$8,000 scrap-and-replace or NT$3,000 new; light/small: 6,500 or 4,500; low-income households 14,000/9,000 (heavy) and 16,500/12,500 (light); four remote districts 9,000/6,000 (heavy) and 10,500/7,500 (light). On top: a one-off battery-rental credit (7,200 heavy, 3,600 light) and a NT$3,000 top-up for one group (parent of a child 12 or under, age 18-30, delivery worker, disaster-affected household). The city's headline best case, including central money, is NT$30,200 (scrapping) and NT$36,200 (low-income), per media quoting the city; no new-purchase total could be verified. Old scooter must be 2015 or earlier; register on the MOENV platform first and pick 臺南市. Buy by 2026-12-31 (36 days left) and register by 2027-01-10. Money is capped at NT$58,300,500 and may run out; we could not check. No 2027 plan yet; no local parking discount since 2023.

findings.conditions: NOWnews (2026-02-27, opened) breaks down a heavy Gogoro Delight (list NT$89,800): MOEA 8,000 + MOENV 4,000 + local 15,200 (=8,000 scrap + 7,200 battery) + Tainan project top-up 3,000 = 30,200; net price 59,600. Needs: heavy class, old scooter scrapped, one qualifying top-up group, battery credit counted, MOENV platform registration first. Without a top-up group the same buyer gets 27,200. Low-income 36,200 = 14,000+7,200+3,000+12,000 central.
findings.status2027: unknown; programme ends 2026-12-31 (applications to 2027-01-10); no 2027 plan seen
findings.verifierNote: Figure confirmed in two opened media pages quoting 環保局 (TVBS 2026-02-10; NOWnews 2026-02-27), not on an opened city page. Period corrected: published Feb 2026, not 2025-12-26. Central split (MOEA 8,000 + MOENV 4,000) now seen in NOWnews citing Gogoro's calculator, so the inference is supported but media-only. City-only part is 18,200 with a top-up, 15,200 without.

findings.conditions: Local part for heavy new purchase by the PDF: 3,000 + 7,200 + 3,000 = 13,200 (general) or 9,000 + 7,200 + 3,000 = 19,200 (low-income). 20,200 / 26,200 would need about 7,000 central, unconfirmed arithmetic.

findings.verifierNote: The cited NOWnews 6790279 page contains no 20,200 or 26,200; it gives only 30,200 / 36,200. No opened page states the city's new-purchase total. Do not publish 20,200 / 26,200 as a city figure.

findings.valueText: Abolished from 2023-10-01 (had been half price per visit for scooters)
findings.sourcePublisher: TVBS 地球黃金線 (citing 臺南市交通局)
findings.sourceTitle: 台南10月1日起取消「電動車路邊停車優惠」
findings.quote: 台南市電動車輛路邊停車將自2023年10月1日起恢復原公告費率收費。
findings.conditions: Previous measure: 汽車前2小時半價、機車當次半價, in force 5 years. 交通局 says it will require 5% / 10% charging bays in outsourced car parks and build 60 smart roadside charging posts.
findings.status2027: ended; no replacement found

findings.subject: Application channels
findings.valueText: 1) MOENV 車輛汰舊換新抵換媒合平臺 (first step for scrap-and-replace; choose 臺南市 in 溫室氣體減量效益); 2) the city-designated claim site, called 台南市機車補助網 by NOWnews; URL not confirmed. Official document: the plan PDF.
findings.sourcePublisher: 臺南市政府環境保護局
findings.sourceTitle: 115年臺南市淘汰老舊機車及換、新購電動二輪車補助方案 (PDF, opened and read)
findings.quote: 申請淘汰換購電動機車補助者，應至環境部汰舊換新媒合平台申請臺南市「淘汰老舊機車換購電動機車溫室氣體減量獎勵金」，始可申請本補助。
findings.conditions: Claims are filed online by the buyer or by the dealer/manufacturer/recycler on the buyer's behalf at the 環保局-designated site. Documents: online affidavit, ID, invoice, 行照 and 新領牌照登記書, bank account.
findings.status2027: unknown; programme ends 2026-12-31 (applications to 2027-01-10); no 2027 plan seen
findings.verifierNote: Site name corrected to NOWnews's '台南市機車補助網'. NOWnews links https://lowpoll2.easylife.net.tw/01_news_view.aspx?news=20251226151741424 as the city notice; that host did not connect, so unverified. 環保局 pages (web.tainan.gov.tw/epb) are script-rendered and epb.tainan.gov.tw is unreachable.

findings.subject: Worked example: Gogoro Delight list 89,800, general scrap-and-replace
findings.valueText: 89,800 list less 30,200 total subsidy = 59,600 (before dealer promotions)
findings.sourcePublisher: NOWnews (citing Gogoro calculator and 臺南市環保局)
findings.sourceTitle: 2026機車補助最新！這縣市加碼「最高領3.6萬」 (2026-02-27)
findings.quote: 一般台南人，不算其他購車優惠的話，光是政府補助，就可以 59,600 元成為車主，中低收入戶再省6000元。
findings.conditions: Assumes new and old owner are the same person and one top-up project applies; the battery-rental part (7,200) is a credit, not a price cut.
findings.status2027: unknown; programme ends 2026-12-31 (applications to 2027-01-10); no 2027 plan seen
findings.verifierNote: Seen on opened NOWnews page; arithmetic matches the PDF. Useful against sub-NT$50k gasoline 125cc leads (outside this scope).

gaps: Official city claim website URL (台南市機車補助網) not confirmed; lowpoll2.easylife.net.tw did not connect and epb.tainan.gov.tw is unreachable.
Whether the NT$58,300,500 budget or any sub-quota has run out as of 2026-11-25 could not be checked; no exhaustion notice seen.
Central MOEA (about 8,000) and MOENV (about 4,000) amounts for 2026 are known only from NOWnews citing Gogoro's calculator, not from a central government page.
City best-case total for new purchase (no scrap) not found on any opened page; the 20,200 / 26,200 figures are unsupported.
No official 環保局 page stating 30,200 / 36,200 was opened; only TVBS and NOWnews quoting the city.
Amendment date of the 70+ licence-surrender top-up not printed in the PDF text (file metadata shows a July 2026 modification date, not reliable as the announcement date).
Whether the battery-rental credit applies to fixed-battery models: media say any replacement or new purchase, official table silent.
Licence-fee waiver (使用牌照稅) is a national rule and was not checked here; no Tainan-specific waiver found.
Operating-cost figures (electricity, battery plan fees, maintenance) are outside this scope and were not researched.
